svg.title: Indochina interlock network
svg.text: 19 firms in 8 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 505 firms, 5,734 interlocks, 9 components (largest 486). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 105 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
